name: query-orchestrator
code_snippet: POST /api/query -> select nodes -> build prompt -> call /api/ai-call -> update brain tags

tags.brain_summary: Coordinates the core query pipeline and merges node context into one prompt.
tags.brain_behavior: Validates query payload, picks node context, and records writes/history.
tags.brain_constraints: Must not embed provider-specific AI logic directly.

tags.brain_summary: Provides JSON-backed node memory persistence and simple node ranking.
tags.brain_behavior: Reads and writes node data from nodes.json and formats prompt context.
tags.brain_constraints: JSON persistence only for v0; not optimized for high concurrency.
tags.brain_context: Acts as memory adapter until a database-backed graph is introduced.

name: callExternalAI
code_snippet: Receives prompt and returns stubbed output. Replace with Gemini/OpenAI call later.

tags.brain_summary: Proxy boundary for external AI providers with no core brain logic.
tags.brain_behavior: Accepts raw prompt, performs remote call (or stub), and returns output.
tags.brain_constraints: Should remain provider-agnostic and not mutate node memory.
tags.brain_context: Decouples orchestration from provider integration details.
